en.Hero:
Your favorite words.
A frame of their own.
en.CardLine:
Keep a little of today.
Make it yours.
en.ReadyBody: Turn lyrics, color and a little space into a card that feels like you.
en.AllUsers: Install for everyone on this computer
en.WorkingBody: Your creative workspace is being installed on this computer.
en.WorkingStatus: Writing application files and system settings…
en.WorkingHint: Installation cannot be cancelled while files are being written. You can close this window when it finishes.
en.DoneBody: Your workspace is ready. Start with a few words that mean something to you.
en.InvalidPath: Choose an application subfolder on a local drive, not a drive root or Windows system folder.
en.Running: Save your work and close Lyrics Card Generator before installing.
en.Failed: Installation did not complete. Check permissions and free disk space, then retry. Error code:
en.Cancelled: Administrator permission was cancelled. Adjust your options and try again.
en.PreviewAction: This is an interface preview. No application will be installed.

fr.Hero:
Vos mots préférés.
Un cadre à eux.
fr.CardLine:
Gardez un peu d’aujourd’hui.
À votre manière.
fr.ReadyBody: Associez paroles, couleurs et espace pour créer une carte à votre image.
fr.Shortcut: Créer un raccourci sur le bureau
fr.WorkingBody: Votre espace de création s’installe sur cet ordinateur.
fr.WorkingStatus: Écriture des fichiers et des paramètres…
fr.WorkingHint: Impossible d’annuler pendant l’écriture des fichiers. Fermez la fenêtre une fois l’installation terminée.

fr.PreviewAction: Ceci est un aperçu de l’interface. Aucune application ne sera installée.
